task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

values.instruction: Write a very brief summary with only one or two sentences.
Write a summary of about three sentences with moderate detail.
Write a detailed summary with multiple sentences and extensive information.

axes.name: sentence_complexity
axes.description: 문장당 단어 수와 문장 구조의 복잡성을 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Use short and simple sentences with straightforward structure.
Use longer sentences with more complex structure and multiple clauses.
Focus on presenting clear, concrete facts without speculation or opinion.
Include interpretations, opinions, or speculative comments along with facts.

axes.name: use_of_names_and_titles
axes.description: 인물 이름과 직함 사용 빈도 및 방식입니다.

values.instruction: Use few names or titles, focusing more on general descriptions.
Include full names and relevant titles or affiliations frequently.
